facts.fact: A GIZ-funded feasibility demonstration with Senegal's health ministry had three Senegalese hospital information system vendors (Patient Pro, Eyone, MedSen) test data exchange under IHE standards at the IHE Europe Connectathon 2024, passing about 90% of planned tests.

SEN.note: IHE profiles are not an ISO, IEC or ITU standard adopted nationally, and no membership is stated.

facts.fact: The source says the next step is for the government to create an interoperability framework defining the standards to be used in Senegal, implying none exists.
The source says the government still needs to set an interoperability framework defining the standards to be used in Senegal, implying no such standards exist.
